findings: S5: 04-uiux-brief.md carries colour as family, tone and shade rather than as hex, and motion as the moment and the character rather than as a duration or a curve. The check asks for literal values; the settled number rule (generate_instruction A5) and source_lint.colour_words forbid them, and the two rules are in direct conflict. The number rule wins as the later and machine-enforced one. Type is the exception it makes and is carried exactly: Nunito, its fallback stack and the measured size scale.

S6: 05-backend-schema.md states each concurrency rule as an observable invariant rather than as a named index or constraint. The check asks for the storage-level construct; G43 (prescription_lint) forbids naming one, and at variant b the reminder clause the check also asks for is the exam and is deleted. Both invariants that matter are present as properties: the seat count never exceeds the cap under simultaneous joins, and a guess is scored once per seat per turn.

B1: the feed-social row seeds one role and three accounts. The brief seeds four accounts across two roles, player and moderator, because the companion's Section 19.5 requires a human to review reports and a reviewer needs an identity. The room owner is a relationship rather than a third role. Recorded as a judgment call in 00-decisions.md.

S1 to S10 otherwise clean: seven docs present, the PRD carries ten must-have features inside the 6-10 companion band and an explicit out-of-scope list, the TRD carries the full stack plus the no-second-store clause, the app-flow document carries a route table, an API listing, entry rules, eight journeys and the states line, the plan carries an exit condition per phase and closes on deploy and self-check, and no placeholder or canary text appears anywhere.

G1 to G3 clean: every seeded email and the corpus password round-trip between the spec folder and the brief, every endpoint in the brief's API-shapes table appears in 03-app-flow.md, and every entry in 00-decisions.md is applied in the brief.

A1: ten of the eleven H2s are present and `## Build plan` is deliberately absent, which generate_instruction 2.1 requires at baseline. `## Front-end specification` is present as the unbudgeted home for a long visual specification, which the same prompt names and which task.toml records as the `frontend` spec token.
B1: the feed-social row seeds one role and three accounts; the brief seeds four across player and moderator. Same judgment call as QC_spec B1, recorded in 00-decisions.md.
B3: two of the three difficulty levers are emitted, `## Technical requirements` and `## Data model`. `## Build plan` is not baseline, so the third is absent by rule rather than by omission.

C1: most numbered entries under Core features state a rule with its negative case and its rejection outcome. A minority state a data shape instead, the six room states, the three word modes and the three guess outcomes, and those carry no negative case because there is nothing to reject.

C5: the Data model states each concurrency rule as an observable invariant and names no index, lock or isolation level, because G43 forbids the construct and variant b deletes the application-level reminder. Derived values are computed on read and seeding is stated idempotent.

C7: Core features runs about 25k characters and the joined six about 45k, past the 2,500 and 9,000 slices run_rubric applies. The tasker instructed that the caps be ignored. Judged scoring does not depend on the brief reaching the judge, because every criterion carries its own facts under G52.

D5 companion contradiction sweep, run sentence by sentence over the design, motion, layout and accessibility prose. No inversion found. The three highest-risk pairs were checked in both directions: reduced motion is carried as nothing removed and only stilled with the countdown continuing, which is the companion's own wording rather than its opposite; the absence of navigation is carried as an absence, not as a minimal bar; and the shadow rule is carried as hard and offset with exactly one soft variant, not as a general softness. One near-miss recorded rather than flagged: the brief calls the motion character springy, and the companion measures four easing curves rather than a spring. It is not an inversion, because the two moments the companion specifies by keyframe both overshoot and settle, and the brief carries the companion's speed rule verbatim in words.

D4: the brief names no external checker anywhere. The word grader does not appear in it at all: the Data model's mandated credentials paragraph is carried with `so a person can sign in`, which is a deliberate one-word deviation from the prompt's verbatim block and is the stronger form under 4.0-B.

TAX-005 caught one real defect and it was corrected before this verdict: `[metadata].language` read `python` while the drawn stack is Hono on SolidStart. It now reads `typescript`, and the `keywords` language token was corrected with it, so INT-004 holds.

ENV-006: `DB_URL` is emitted alongside `DATABASE_URL` with the same value. It is off-canon against QC_spec 5.2 and is what the shipped environments export, per generate_instruction 2.3. Recorded as a Low observation, not a defect.
TAX-014c: `P1-db` is legal for the (solo_founder, feed-social) cell and its slot set is exactly `{db}`, which equals `[metadata.services]` once `db` normalises to `backend`.

INST-003: the one graded capability that needs an inspection credential is the datastore, and `[verifier].env` carries `DB_ADMIN_URL`. No email, payments or storage slot is declared, so VERIF-007 is NOT-APPLICABLE.

SEC-001 to SEC-004 clean: `DB_ADMIN_URL` appears in `[verifier].env` only, the agent environment carries no admin credential, every literal is either a `${VAR}` expansion or the documented local-dev convention value, and `canary_present = true` is retained.

BENCH-003 is read against the calibration placeholder rather than a declared difficulty: `difficulty = ""` is what the author must emit, and the emitted budget of 200 turns and 7,500,000 tokens sits inside the absolute range BENCH-004 fixes.

RUN-001 and RUN-003: the base is the corpus skeleton `python:3.12-slim-bookworm` and Node 20 is installed explicitly, which is the runtime the drawn stack needs. The base is pinned by tag, so ARCH-002 and ARCH-003 are NOT-APPLICABLE: there is no manifest-list choice to make and no digest to trace.

DEP-011 is NOT-APPLICABLE: `[verifier].environment_mode` is `separate`, so the grader ships its own image and this one owes it no Python package. The pinned set is installed anyway and is exempt from DEP-004 as the GRADER RUNTIME set.
DEP-017 is NOT-APPLICABLE: `[metadata].language` is typescript, so no JRE is owed.

DEP-012 and DEP-014 are the two that matter here and both hold: Chromium's system libraries are installed explicitly with a `playwright install chromium` step, and `postgresql-client` supplies the `pg_isready` the healthcheck names.
CMP-011 is a WARN rather than a finding: no sidecar publishes a host port, and the single `ports` key is on `main`, which CMP-022 requires. The two rows overlap and CMP-022 is the specific one.

ENV-003 NOT-APPLICABLE: no `VOLUME` is required and none is present. SEC-003 NOT-APPLICABLE: the corpus skeleton establishes root execution in the agent image and no source establishes a non-root convention.
BP-009 holds mechanically: `environment/Dockerfile`, `tests/Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yaml` carry zero `#` lines, which G50 confirms.

The prompt declares no machine-readable check registry, so the receipt carries a run verdict rather than a scorecard. checklist_qc.py is green on structure, ids, citations and ledger arithmetic, and the coverage join is green in both directions: 340 of 340 items carry a citation, and every citation names an item that exists.

Hat 1, the Adjudicator: the machine report raised no uncovered obligation and no possible invention. Four items were checked by hand against the brief lines they restate and all four are confirmed matches.

Hat 2, the Doubter of COVERED: every pairing on a brief sentence carrying two verbs was read. One partial capture was found and closed before this verdict: the canvas rule originally folded the whole-canvas image and the changed-region image into one item, and the second half went nowhere. The brief now states both and the checklist carries them as separate items.

Hat 3, the Reader of Silence: the sentences the scan classified as carrying no obligation are the brief's rationale clauses, the ones that explain why a rule exists rather than state it. Each was read and none carries an ask of its own.
Hat 4, the Arithmetician: the coverage ledger's items-produced column equals the body count in every section, and every section's item count exceeds its obligation-sentence count.

Three unpinned literals are declared rather than flagged: the exact shade of every colour role, the exact size of the layout unit and the exact duration of every moment. All three are values the number rule hands to the builder on purpose, and nothing downstream asserts them.
